doc_title: CONSENT BY THE ENCUMBRANCER TO TRANSFER
doc_title_official: CONSENT BY THE ENCUMBRANCER TO TRANSFER
when_used: The holder of an encumbrance over a title consents to a transfer of that title so that the transfer can be registered.

body_text.text: National Identity Card/Certificate of incorporation/Registration Number(s)/{{vendor_id}} and of P.O Box Number {{encumbrancer_po_box}}
being the encumbrancer of the above title hereby acknowledge and declare that :-
I/We have full knowledge of this Transfer;
I/We understand the nature and effect of this Transfer;
I/We acknowledge that I/We have taken legal advice regarding the nature, remedies and effect of this Transfer; and
Neither the Transferor nor the Transferee have used any compulsion or threat or exercised undue influence on me/us to induce me/us to execute this consent;
AND I/We HEREBY CONSENT to the said Transfer

execution.verification_heading: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act (for individuals)

custom_fields.name: encumbrancer_po_box
custom_fields.label: Post Office Box Number of the encumbrancer
custom_fields.prompt: Postal box number of the encumbrancer giving the consent, for example 1-00100
